skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_1.name: Mace Mastery I
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_1.descripti: Grants Wind Burst I, Density I and Breach I/nThe mace also gains a pale grey tint
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_2.name: Mace Mastery II
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_2.descripti: Upgrades to Wind Burst II, Density II and Breach II/nThe mace's tint turns green
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_3.name: Mace Mastery III
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_3.descripti: Upgrades to Wind Burst III, Density III and Breach III/nThe mace's tint turns blue
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_4.name: Mace Mastery IV
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_4.descripti: Upgrades to Density IV and Breach IV (Wind Burst stays III)/nThe mace's tint turns purple
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_5.name: Mace Mastery V
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_5.descripti: Upgrades to Density V and Breach V, and adds Fire Aspect I/nThe mace's tint turns fiery red-orange
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_6.name: Mace Mastery VI
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_6.descripti: Upgrades Breach to VI (Density stays V) and grants continuous Haste I while the mace is carried/nThe mace's tint turns orange
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_7.name: Mace Mastery VII
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_7.descripti: Upgrades to Fire Aspect II (Density and Breach stay VI), and grants continuous Fire Resistance I while the mace is carried/nUnlocks Dash: right-click to lunge forward, 2.5s cooldown/nThe mace's tint turns a dark ember red
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_8.name: Mace Mastery VIII
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_8.descripti: Upgrades to Density VI and Breach VI (Wind Burst stays III), and grants continuous Speed I while the mace is carried/nThe mace's tint turns a deep burnt orange
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_9.name: Mace Mastery IX
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_9.descripti: Density and Breach stay VI (cap reached), and grants continuous Resistance I on top of Haste I/nUnlocks Stun: melee hits have a chance to stun the target/nThe mace's tint turns a deep rust red
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_10.name: Mace Mastery X
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_10.descript: Upgrades to Density VI and Breach VI (cap reached), and grants continuous Strength I on top of Fire Resistance I/nUnlocks Light Foot: no fall damage while the mace is carried/nThe mace's tint turns gold
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_11.name: Mace Mastery XI - Netherite Master Mace
skill.skilltree.mace_mastery_11.descript: Density and Breach stay VI (cap reached), upgrades Fire Aspect to III, and grants Haste I, Speed I, Fire Resistance I, Strength I, Resistance I and Regeneration I, all at once, while the mace is carried/nCombines Light Foot, Dash and Stun, and unlocks God: crouch and right-click to unleash a devastating shockwave around you, 60s cooldown/nThe mace's tint turns netherite black
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.haste.des: Grants continuous Haste I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.speed.des: Grants continuous Speed I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.fire_resi: Grants continuous Fire Resistance I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.dash.name: Dash [120 kills]
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.dash.desc: Right-click to lunge forward in the direction you're looking. 2.5s cooldown.
Grants continuous Strength I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.light_foo: Negates all fall damage while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.resistanc: Grants continuous Resistance I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.stun.name: Stun [135 kills]
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.stun.desc: Melee hits have a 15% chance to stun the target for 3s.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.regenerat: Grants continuous Regeneration I while the mace is carried.
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.god.name: God [150 kills]
skilltree.mace_mastery_tooltip.god.descr: Crouch and right-click to unleash a devastating shockwave around you. 60s cooldown.
